sections.title: A word for what you always do
sections.content: szokás ("habit, custom") works the same way élet did back in Unit 5 — take the have-construction you already know and add a possessive suffix. rendszeresen ("regularly") is the natural adverb to pair it with, alongside együtt ("together"), which you already know.
szokásunk ("our habit") uses the same possessive -unk you already know from autónk ("our car") back in A1 — one more noun added to a pattern you have down cold.
